content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows users to deploy websites directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means they can set up a professional online store without the burden of typical platform fees. Unlike traditional platforms that charge hefty transaction rates—Gumroad, for example, takes a 10% cut—GitHub Pages combined with NOWPayments offers a much leaner alternative at just 0.5%. This lower fee structure translates into significant savings, especially if you're selling high-ticket items like courses or ebooks.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the setup involves several key components. GitHub Pages serves as the front-end hosting platform where your store resides. Automated scripts, like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, manage backend logic, processing orders and delivering digital products seamlessly. NOWPayments facilitates instant cryptocurrency payments, providing real-time transaction verification without the need for traditional banking. This architecture not only ensures that your store operates efficiently but also empowers you with full control over your data and transactions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who operate in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Whether you're an author selling ebooks, a designer offering fonts, or an educator providing online courses, this stack gives you the tools to sell directly to your audience without intermediary platforms that charge high fees. It’s built for creators who value ownership and want to build a sustainable income stream without the usual constraints.
GitHub Pages offers free hosting for digital stores.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of this setup relies on several interlinked components. GitHub Pages handles website hosting with ease, while backend scripts automate processes like order management and product delivery. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly to handle crypto transactions, allowing customers to pay in over 300 cryptocurrencies. This combination not only reduces operational costs but also enhances user experience by providing instant delivery and payment confirmation. Each component works in concert to create a robust digital commerce solution.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, set up a GitHub account and create a new repository for your store. Use GitHub Pages to host your site and configure it to showcase your digital products. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage your backend logic for processing orders and delivering files. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions effortlessly. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything you need to deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, significantly lower than conventional platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for ways to effectively sell digital products without relying on platforms like Gumroad or PayPal, explore our Complete Builder Kit ($197). This resource offers you all six blueprints and seven templates needed to create your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by signing up for a GitHub account. Next, create a repository to host your digital store. Configure GitHub Pages to publish your site. Set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend automation. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. Test the entire flow to ensure seamless operations. Finally, launch your store and start promoting your products to your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can utilize GitHub Pages for free hosting, combined with automated delivery tools and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. This approach allows you to manage sales directly without relying on conventional platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Using GitHub Pages along with NOWPayments is an effective method. This combination allows you to host your store at no cost while keeping transaction fees minimal, maximizing your profits.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Absolutely. By setting up your own store on GitHub Pages and integrating NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers without incurring platform fees.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of just 0.5%. This enables you to offer your customers diverse payment options while keeping costs low.
How can I automate product delivery?

Utilizing Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers will automate product delivery. These tools can handle order processing and ensure customers receive their digital products instantly after payment confirmation.
You maintain full ownership and control of your digital products.
